channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-120472 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9 | A flaw was found in OpenShift Hive. The ClusterClaim controller assigns hive-claim-owner RBAC based on a user-controlled ClusterClaim.spec.namespace and only verifies ClusterPoolRef.ClaimName. A tenant can point a same-named claim at another tenant's ClusterDeployment and obtain get access to that cluster's admin kubeconfig and admin password secrets.

item.title: CVE-2026-121811 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Pleasanter contains an issue with improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('Path Traversal') in the API. If this vulnerability is exploited, an arbitrary file on the server where the product is running may be obtained by a remote authenticated attacker.

item.title: CVE-2026-125276 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Pleasanter contains an issue with insertion of sensitive information into sent data in the API. If the affected product receives a specially crafted API request sent by a remote authenticated attacker, the authentication credentials of other users, including administrators, such as API keys, may be obtained. As a result, the attacker may perform arbitrary operations on the affected product with the privileges associated with the obtained credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-125411 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Pleasanter contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the access control of Items. If this vulnerability is exploited, a remote authenticated attacker who can view records in the affected product may obtain the values of Items for which read access is restricted by Column access control. Note that the vulnerability affects configurations where read access conditions are set in Column access control settings.

item.title: CVE-2026-131800 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an organization member with permission to manage custom-property definitions and edit property values to add an attacker-controlled SSH authentication key to the personal account of another member through HTML stored in a single-select custom-property option. Exploitation required another definition manager in the same organization to attempt to remove the poisoned option while it was in use and save the definition with a valid sudo session. Repository access through the added key depended on the permissions of the victim and independent authorization controls. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

item.title: CVE-2026-131871 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | WLA DX 9.7 through 10.7 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in parse_data_blocks() in wlalink/analyze.c that copies section namespaces without length checks. Attackers can supply a crafted object or library file with a namespace longer than 255 bytes or unterminated to overflow the 256-byte stack buffer when linked.

item.title: CVE-2026-131872 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | SOIL2 before 1.4.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in its DDS, PVR and PKM image loaders that write results through unchecked caller-supplied output pointers. Attackers can supply a valid DDS, PVR or PKM file to applications passing NULL output pointers to SOIL_load_image or stbi_info, causing a crash.

item.title: CVE-2026-131873 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Gargoyle 2023.1 through 2026.1.1 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the bundled Plus interpreter's ReadAction() function in terps/plus/loaddatabase.c, which never bounds-checks the index into the 1024-entry conditions array. Attackers can supply a crafted or truncated .plus game file with unterminated action conditions to write file-controlled values past the array and crash the player.

item.title: CVE-2026-131874 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | Gargoyle 2023.1 through 2026.1.1 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the bundled Plus interpreter's ReadString() function in terps/plus/loaddatabase.c that fails to handle end of file. Attackers can supply an empty, truncated, or crafted .plus game file that hangs Gargoyle at full CPU until the user kills it.

item.title: CVE-2026-131875 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | fqterm before 0.9.11 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in FQTermDecode that allows malicious servers to corrupt memory by sending CSI sequences with unbounded parameter indexes. Attackers controlling a telnet or SSH server, or intercepting cleartext telnet, can send over 30 semicolon-separated CSI parameters to write chosen 32-bit values past the decoder object on the heap.

item.title: CVE-2026-131876 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | fqterm 0.9.9 before 0.9.11 contains an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability in its SSH client that trusts unchecked server-supplied length fields for allocations, copies and read positions. Malicious servers or man-in-the-middle attackers can send crafted lengths in getString(), KEXINIT name-lists, key parsing or packet framing before host key verification to crash the client.

item.title: CVE-2026-101113 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Multiple ELECOM wireless LAN routers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that may cause an arbitrary OS command to be executed by an attacker who can access the administrative interface of the affected product.

item.title: CVE-2026-130121 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The AI Puffer - MCP Server for Claude & ChatGPT, with AI Chatbot plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via AI-generated comment replies in all versions up to, and including, 2.5.28 due to insufficient sanitization of the AI model's output in the insert_comment_reply_logic() function, which saves replies with wp_insert_comment() and bypasses the kses filtering WordPress normally applies to comment content. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page, by submitting a comment that leads the AI model to reproduce an HTML payload in its automated reply. This is only exploitable when an administrator has configured a Comment Auto-Reply automation task with 'Action on reply' set to 'Approve' (the default is 'Hold for moderation'), and the attacker's comment has been approved.

item.title: CVE-2026-130644 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1 | A path traversal flaw was found in ansible-core. When installing a collection with ansible-galaxy collection install, the install destination directory is derived from the namespace and name fields declared inside the collection artifact's own metadata, which are not validated as well-formed collection identifiers or checked for path containment. A malicious collection artifact -- delivered as a local file, a remote URL, a source directory, a git repository, or as a dependency -- can use a crafted name value to redirect the install destination outside the configured collections path, causing ansible-galaxy to delete an existing directory writable by the invoking user and then write attacker-controlled files to that location.

item.title: CVE-2026-117657 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | A Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information (CWE-319) vulnerability exists in the Android application "Imperial Palaces Guide" provided by The Imperial Household Agency. A man-in-the-middle attacker may be able to tamper with data transmitted between the application and the server, resulting in the display of modified content to users.

item.title: CVE-2026-118900 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.4
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.4 | An OS command injection vulnerability exists in the Android application "Imperial Palaces Guide" provided by The Imperial Household Agency. An attacker may be able to execute arbitrary OS commands with the privileges of the application.

item.title: CVE-2026-104683 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Envira Gallery WordPress plugin before 1.16.4 does not apply its own gallery-permission policy until an administrator first opens its permissions screen, instead copying gallery-management capabilities onto each role from that role's core post capabilities after activation, which lets Contributor accounts create, edit and delete galleries that the policy is meant to restrict to higher roles.

item.title: CVE-2026-107099 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Royal Addons for Elementor WordPress plugin before 1.7.1071 does not restrict or validate the post meta keys used when counting or rendering a filtered grid, and does not reject private (hidden) meta keys, allowing unauthenticated users to disclose the value of arbitrary private post meta one value at a time from the filtered result count. This is an incomplete fix of CVE-2026-17585, whose 1.7.1067 patch covered only a separate search-based path and left the grid filtering path affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-107739 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Search & Replace WordPress plugin before 3.2.4 does not correctly restrict which database tables an administrator of a single site may operate on in a multisite network, allowing subsite administrators to read and modify the tables of other sites and of the network, and to make themselves Super Admin.

item.title: CVE-2026-107740 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Search & Replace WordPress plugin before 3.2.4 does not restrict one of its database tools to network administrators on multisite installations, allowing administrators of a single subsite to run arbitrary SQL against the whole network's database and make themselves Super Admin.

item.title: CVE-2026-111825 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The Event Tickets with Ticket Scanner plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'code' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload persists through WooCommerce session data into order-item metadata and executes when rendered in the ticket scanner interface.

item.title: CVE-2026-117489 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Flatsome WordPress theme before 3.20.13 does not perform a capability or nonce check on an AJAX action available to authenticated users, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to disclose the name and content of non-public templates stored on the site.

item.title: CVE-2026-117491 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Flatsome WordPress theme before 3.20.13 does not verify that the acting user is authorised to modify the target post when saving a template, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to overwrite the content and type of an arbitrary post, including another user's published page, removing it from the front end.

item.title: CVE-2026-117492 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Flatsome WordPress theme before 3.20.13 does not sanitise post meta saved through an AJAX action, nor escape it when rendering the product page, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor (who lack the unfiltered_html capability) to store JavaScript that executes in the browser of anyone who views the product, including administrators.

item.title: CVE-2026-117520 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Dynific Addons for Elementor (formerly Anywhere Elementor) WordPress plugin before 1.3.1 does not perform a capability check on an AJAX action that stores a configuration value, allowing any authenticated user, including Subscribers, to store a value that is later output without proper escaping in a quoted attribute on an administrator settings page, resulting in Stored Cross-Site Scripting that executes in the administrator's session.

item.title: CVE-2026-120390 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging WordPress plugin before 0.9.140 does not limit its table prefix rewrite to table names when restoring a database backup, which corrupts the length of stored serialized values and allows users with a role as low as Subscriber to plant a PHP object that WordPress instantiates after an administrator restores a backup.

item.title: CVE-2026-120391 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging WordPress plugin before 0.9.140 does not prevent serialized data it cannot safely unserialize from being re-serialized as a PHP object during a site migration, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to plant a PHP object that WordPress instantiates after an administrator restores a backup onto a different URL.

item.title: CVE-2026-120406 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin before 6.2.5 does not check that the post a form submission says it was sent from is publicly viewable before resolving post-related mail-tags, allowing unauthenticated users to obtain the title, URL, author name and author email of private, draft and trashed posts where such tags are used in an email or message returned to the submitter.

item.title: CVE-2026-123132 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Otter Blocks WordPress plugin before 3.2.10 does not use URL-aware escaping when it resolves its dynamic data tags inside HTML attributes, which could allow unauthenticated users to post comments containing links that execute arbitrary JavaScript when clicked, for example by a logged-in administrator.

item.title: CVE-2026-123662 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The ProfilePress WordPress plugin before 4.18.1 does not atomically consume the source subscription when processing a membership plan change, allowing a customer to submit concurrent plan-change checkouts against a single paid subscription and obtain several active memberships for the price of one.

item.title: CVE-2026-126040 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Hide My WP Ghost WordPress plugin before 7.0.19 only enforces two-factor authentication on the interactive login flow and not on other authentication paths, allowing an attacker who already has a user's valid password to authenticate as that user without completing the second factor.

item.title: CVE-2026-126041 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Hide My WP Ghost WordPress plugin before 7.0.19 does not remove or restrict a debug branch in its output rewriting, allowing unauthenticated attackers to reveal the hidden login page, the hidden admin path and the renamed content folders the Hide My WP Ghost WordPress plugin before 7.0.19 is meant to conceal.

item.title: CVE-2026-127003 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The RSVP and Event Management WordPress plugin before 2.7.19 does not sanitise and escape attendee data imported from a spreadsheet before outputting it on the frontend RSVP form, which could allow users with the Author role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against anyone, including administrators, viewing the affected attendee, even when the unfiltered_html capability is disallowed.

item.title: CVE-2026-127021 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Flamix: Bitrix24 and WooCommerce Products Sync WordPress plugin before 1.7.0 does not restrict or validate an unauthenticated file-exchange request, allowing anyone to write a file with an attacker-chosen name, extension and path to a web-served location and thereby execute arbitrary PHP.

item.title: CVE-2026-128851 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Probono Form Basic WordPress plugin before 1.3.3 does not validate the real type of files uploaded through its public form, trusting the client-declared MIME type instead, which could allow unauthenticated attackers to upload PHP files to a public directory and execute them before they are deleted, on servers that do not honour the Probono Form Basic WordPress plugin before 1.3.3's Apache-only access restriction.

item.title: CVE-2026-129434 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The OneLogin SAML SSO WordPress plugin before 3.7.1 does not validate a user-supplied parameter before using it to redirect an already-authenticated user, allowing unauthenticated attackers to redirect a logged-in user to an arbitrary external domain via a crafted link (e.g. for phishing).

item.title: CVE-2026-5765 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | The Essential Real Estate plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 5.3.3 via deserialization of untrusted input in the 'saved_search_check_result' function. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to inject a PHP Object. No known POP chain is present in the vulnerable software, which means this vulnerability has no impact unless another plugin or theme containing a POP chain is installed on the site. If a POP chain is present via an additional plugin or theme installed on the target system, it may allow the attacker to perform actions like delete arbitrary files, retrieve sensitive data, or execute code depending on the POP chain present.

item.title: CVE-2026-75795 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Edwiser Bridge WordPress plugin before 4.3.5 does not correctly scope one of its REST API authentication checks, disabling WordPress's REST nonce validation for every route on the site, which allows attackers to make a logged-in administrator perform arbitrary privileged actions, such as creating a new administrator account, via CSRF.

item.title: CVE-2026-97329 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Team Members WordPress plugin before 5.4.2 does not properly escape a team member field when it is rendered back in the administration area, allowing users with the contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against higher-privileged users who edit the team.

item.title: CVE-2026-97330 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Team Members WordPress plugin before 5.4.2 does not properly escape team member social link URLs when they are rendered back in the administration area, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against higher privileged users who edit the team.
